work.name: OpkodeLabs
work.summary: Developed WattLink, a multi-tenant EV charging management platform with Laravel, PostgreSQL, Redis, Socket.IO, Docker, and Grafana, enabling operators to monitor station status, configure pricing, and track telemetry.
highlights: Built a real-time monitoring system with Laravel, PostgreSQL, Redis Pub/Sub, Socket.IO, and Grafana.
Implemented remote control workflows for charging sessions, pricing updates, and operational visibility.
Designed secure multi-tenant patterns to isolate customer data and service operations.
Delivered production-ready infrastructure and tooling with Python and Docker orchestration.

work.name: HexaFlow
work.summary: Developed dynamic web applications with React, Next.js, Node.js, Java, Docker, Terraform, and Azure while improving system architecture and cloud deployment patterns.
highlights: Delivered customer-facing features in agile teams with a focus on maintainability and rapid releases.
Improved deployment workflows by integrating Docker and cloud infrastructure automation.
Modernized frontend and backend interactions to provide a smoother user experience.
Worked across React, Next.js, Node.js, Java, Docker, Terraform, and Azure for scalable delivery.

work.name: Wecraft
work.summary: Developed and maintained a CRM platform for pharmaceutical laboratories with React, Quarkus, Docker, JWT, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB, covering both UI and backend workflows.
highlights: Implemented laboratory operations interfaces for data entry, workflows, and internal business processes.
Built backend services and rules for product, customer, and order management.
Added automated testing across the stack to reduce regressions and improve release stability.
Delivered a reliable SaaS workflow that supported research, sales, and compliance needs.
